narrative.overview: Eight implementations of the same fictional restaurant share semantic content and page-kind operators. This scoped record describes the retained feedback revision, not a selected production identity. The factual organizing phrase below is documentation language, not an approved creative workshop result. Every current revision is AWAITING_USER_REVIEW.
keyCharacteristics: Photography supplies atmosphere and illustration; bound facts supply restaurant information.
Eight separate identities remain visible through shared semantic interiors.
Useful navigation, local demo actions, explicit provider loading and motion preferences remain part of the visual system.

rules.name: The World Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep each candidate's own palette and lettering attached to its operator; the shared renderer does not imply one combined brand.

rules.name: The Page-Kind Rule
rules.body: Change composition with the visitor's task: menu rows, reservation planner, story spread, map, disclosure, editorial list, quotations and contact choices.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Photography never establishes recipe, allergen, nutrition, business or location facts. Keep illustrative and fictional labels and credit access visible.

dos: Do preserve the user-liked 01/02 entry geometry, 03 left desktop rail and fire, and 04 wine/parsley collage with upright Fraunces.
Do keep photos on all 40 dish details, eight category bindings and the four existing manual dish videos.
Do keep the eight clear public destinations, keyboard focus, mobile reflow, local demo labels and linked credits.
Do load the embedded map only after its own action and request location only after its separate action.
Do honor reduced motion, save-data, visibility and the navigation pause/resume utility.
donts: Don't promote any current revision to user-approved or production-ready.
Don't infer facts from stock photography or represent the example map point as a real La Mesa venue.
Don't advertise the retired Pedidos URL or turn the local planner into a submitted reservation.
Don't replace distinct page-kind structure with a repeated title-and-body template.
Don't treat inherited craft-floor drift as a reusable system rule.
